messages:
diego: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we observed another VPC peering isolation with cust-raven where the on-prem firewall clears NDP/ARP table during config churn and our session keepalives keep routing to dead MACs. filing actions here.
nina: ack, recurring pattern matches the 'stale-neighbor' regression we logged earlier. needs short-term and long-term work.
samir: short-term mitigation idea: reduce internal keepalive to 8s and add a 3x NACK backoff before reusing cached next-hops. I can prototype.
diego: action A -> @samir to prototype keepalive/backoff patch, open changelist and test in staging. ETA 36h. (CHG-4219)
maria-g: action B -> @nina to update private-deploy runbook: add ARP/NDP sanity checks and `arping -c 5 -f <ip>` verification step; include expected RTT thresholds. ETA Tue EOD.
platform-se: action C -> coordinate maintenance window with cust-raven: we prefer Wed 0400 UTC 30m. will prepare rollback plan and communications.
ops-bot: tracker-note: created incident follow-up ticket IF-2026, linked to CHG-4219 and runbook task RN-88.
samir: testing note: will run against onprem simulator with topology churn script: `tools/churn-sim --duration 5m --rate 20` and post logs.
nina: long-term: propose adding active neighbor validation in the agent (probe+ARP cache verify) before routing traffic to a previously-cached host. filing spike SPK-314 for Q2.
diego: also adding tenant scan: run a query for customers with firewall models matching `EdgeGuard-X*` and `FortiGate-5k` — if cluster present, we'll flag them for proactive outreach.
maria-g: canary plan: rollout pattern 2% -> 10% -> 50% with 30m observation windows, automatic rollback on >3 connection flaps in window. ops requires manual approval at 10% -> 50%.
platform-se: SE confirmed cust-raven ok with Wed window; will run pre-checks 1h prior and verify `arp -n` entries.
samir: opened draft CL: https://rwd.internal/changes/sg/cl/4382, added unit test and integration harness run 2/2 green.
nina: updated runbook PR: https://rwd.internal/docs/rn-88, added `arping` examples and a quick remediation checklist.
diego: summary: owners: samir (patch CHG-4219), nina (runbook RN-88 + tenant scan), platform-se (cust coordination). timelines: patch 36h, runbook Tue EOD, maintenance Wed 04:00 UTC.
maria-g: please post short updates here as tasks progress so I can mark IF-2026 items resolved. :white_check_mark:
